drafts.subject: Re: Prospective GSoC contributor - where to start?
drafts.message:
Hello Fatima,

Thank you for reaching out and expressing your interest in contributing to Jaseci. It's great to hear that you're preparing ahead for the next GSoC.

Given your comfort with Python and your efforts in learning Jac, I would recommend starting with our 'good-first-issues' in the Jaseci repository. These issues are specifically curated to help new contributors get involved. You can find them by navigating to our GitHub page and filtering the issues by the 'good first issue' label.

Additionally, our main repository, 'jaseci-core,' is a great place to start as it contains the core components of Jaseci. Engaging with this repository will give you a solid understanding of the project's architecture and functionality.

If you have any further questions or need more guidance, feel free to reach out. We are always here to help.

Looking forward to your contributions!

Best regards,

[Your Name]  
Impact Team, Jaseci

drafts.subject: Re: Bug: edge traversal returns duplicates after node delete (repro attached)
drafts.message:
Hi Omar,

Thank you for reaching out and providing a detailed reproduction scenario for the issue you've encountered with edge traversal returning duplicate edges after node deletion.

Currently, this appears to be a new issue that hasn't been documented yet, and there is no known workaround available at this time. We recommend proceeding with filing a GitHub issue, as you suggested, including all the relevant details. This will help our development team to prioritize and address the bug promptly.

We appreciate your cooperation and understanding as we work towards a resolution. Please let us know if there's anything else we can do to assist you further.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
Impact Team
